provenance.note: Written by hand by the AI Researcher. No Claude call has run: no key was set. These are expected labels, not observed model output. All fixtures are invented; none come from a real shop.
provenance.fixtures_checked: 2026-11-06, against the working tree of branch ai-chat-v1: runs.ts adds previous_from and previous_to to collections_week

how_to_use: For each case call checkReply(case.reply, fixtures[case.fixture], stand_ins[case.fixture] ?? {}). Fixtures are in the shape toModelFigures produces: stand-ins in place, no ids. Gate on every case with known_limit false. known_limit cases are wrong answers that a number check cannot see, so they document a limit and must not be gated as passes.

labels.expected: should_pass or should_fail: the right verdict, not the current result.
labels.judgement: True when the label is a policy choice. Flip it deliberately, not to make a test pass.
labels.known_limit: True when the reply is wrong but only a check beyond numbers could catch it.
labels.baseline_guard: What checkReply returned at the commit in baseline.guard_commit. Filled by a script. A mismatch with expected is a tuning target.
labels.ruling_changes: cash_bank-06 was flipped to should_fail by Lead ruling. profit_month-13, collections_week-14 and top_dues-18 stopped being known limits when the guard gained the checks that catch them. baseline_guard still records commit 11ebd5c. The 19 purchases_month, supplier_dues, top_suppliers and cost_up cases were added on branch ask-purchases; their baseline_guard is the guard at that branch, not 11ebd5c. The 20 dues_overdue, credit_sales_month, cash_today and payment_mix_month cases were added on branch ask-dues-cash; their baseline_guard is the guard at that branch. The 24 payroll_month, salary_due, attendance_today and attendance_month cases were added on branch ask-staff; their baseline_guard is the guard at that branch, which reads "half day" and "आधा दिन" as an attendance mark, not an amount.
